access_drivers.description: List of access driver modules. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#access_drivers = [ "polkit" ]).

admin_keepalive_count.description: Admin keepalive count. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#admin_keepalive_count = 5).

admin_keepalive_interval.description: Admin keepalive interval. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#admin_keepalive_interval = 5).

admin_keepalive_required.description: Admin keepalive required (deprecated). Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#admin_keepalive_required = 1).

admin_max_client_requests.description: Limit on concurrent requests for admin connections. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#admin_max_client_requests = 5).

admin_max_clients.description: Maximum number of admin client connections. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#admin_max_clients = 5).

admin_max_queued_clients.description: Maximum queue length for admin client connections. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#admin_max_queued_clients = 5).

admin_max_workers.description: Maximum number of admin worker threads. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#admin_max_workers = 5).

admin_min_workers.description: Minimum number of admin worker threads. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#admin_min_workers = 1).

audit_level.description: Audit level (0=disable, 1=enable if host enabled, 2=enable and exit if disabled). Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#audit_level = 2).

audit_logging.description: Send audit messages via libvirt logging infrastructure. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#audit_logging = 1).

auth_unix_ro.description: Authentication scheme for UNIX read-only sockets. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#auth_unix_ro = "polkit").

auth_unix_rw.description: Authentication scheme for UNIX read-write sockets. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#auth_unix_rw = "polkit").

host_uuid.description: Static UUID of the host. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#host_uuid = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000").

host_uuid_source.description: Source for host UUID. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#host_uuid_source = "smbios").

keepalive_count.description: Maximum number of keepalive messages without response. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#keepalive_count = 5).

keepalive_interval.description: Interval in seconds for keepalive messages. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#keepalive_interval = 5).

keepalive_required.description: Keepalive required (deprecated). Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#keepalive_required = 1).

log_filters.description: Logging filters string. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#log_filters="1:qemu 1:libvirt 4:object 4:json 4:event 1:util").

log_level.description: General logging level (1=DEBUG, 2=INFO, 3=WARNING, 4=ERROR). Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#log_level = 3).

log_outputs.description: Logging outputs string. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#log_outputs="3:syslog:virtstoraged").

max_anonymous_clients.description: Maximum length of queue of accepted but not yet authenticated clients. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#max_anonymous_clients = 20).

max_client_requests.description: Limit on concurrent requests from a single client connection. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#max_client_requests = 5).

max_clients.description: Maximum number of concurrent client connections. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#max_clients = 5000).

max_queued_clients.description: Maximum length of queue of connections waiting to be accepted. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#max_queued_clients = 1000).

max_workers.description: Maximum number of worker threads. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#max_workers = 20).

min_workers.description: Minimum number of worker threads to start. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#min_workers = 5).

ovs_timeout.description: Timeout for Open vSwitch calls. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#ovs_timeout = 5).

prio_workers.description: Number of priority worker threads. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#prio_workers = 5).

sasl_allowed_username_list.description: List of allowed SASL usernames. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#sasl_allowed_username_list = ["joe@EXAMPLE.COM", "fred@EXAMPLE.COM" ]).

unix_sock_admin_perms.description: Permissions for the admin UNIX socket. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#unix_sock_admin_perms = "0700").

unix_sock_dir.description: Directory where UNIX sockets are created. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#unix_sock_dir = "/run/libvirt").

unix_sock_group.description: Group ownership of the UNIX domain socket. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#unix_sock_group = "libvirt").

unix_sock_ro_perms.description: Permissions for the R/O UNIX socket. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#unix_sock_ro_perms = "0777").

unix_sock_rw_perms.description: Permissions for the R/W UNIX socket. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#unix_sock_rw_perms = "0770").
